# [TASK] Authenticate ai-service's entry points and stop trusting interpolated text as structure

## Task

Authenticate every entry point into ai-service and stop trusting caller-controlled text as structure.

- REST: user-scoped endpoints (`/chat`, `/recommendations`, `/search/semantic`) now take the caller's identity from the gateway-issued `X-User-Id` header (`dev.lmdb.ai.security.CallerIdentity`) instead of a request-body field, with a 401 mapping for a missing or unusable header.
- api-gateway: `JwtAuthenticationFilter` now strips any client-supplied `X-User-*` header on every inbound request, on every path (public and protected), before doing anything else — the gateway is the sole author of those headers.
- gRPC: every RPC on ai-service's gRPC surface is now authenticated by a `ServerInterceptor` against a shared service token, fail-closed when unconfigured.
- Prompt construction: conversation history is passed to the model as typed messages instead of concatenated `"role: content"` text; caller- and catalog-sourced text interpolated into prompts is flattened and length-capped first.
- Supply chain: the Vosk speech-to-text model fetched at image build time is now checksum-verified before being unpacked.

## Parent Story

Parent: #192

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] User-scoped REST endpoints reject a request with no valid caller-identity header
- [x] api-gateway forwards no client-supplied identity header on any path
- [x] The gRPC surface rejects any call that doesn't present the configured token, and fails closed when no token is configured
- [x] Model prompts cannot have additional turns or instructions forged into them via interpolated text
- [x] The Docker build fails if the fetched Vosk archive doesn't match its pinned checksum
- [x] Existing and new tests pass for every change above
